# Anivex Solution — Complete AI Search Knowledge Base

> Anivex Solution (https://anivexsolution.in/) is an Indian software engineering and IT solutions company founded by Krishndas Chauhan. We design and engineer custom websites, full-stack web applications, GST-ready ERP software, mobile apps, and workflow automation systems for growing businesses across Jaunpur, Machhlishahar, Lucknow, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, and pan-India.

## 2. Why Businesses Choose Anivex Solution

1. **Custom Engineering (Zero Template Bloat):** Purpose-built React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud database architectures rather than fragile cookie-cutter plugins.
2. **100% Source Code & IP Ownership:** Upon final settlement, clients receive full repository access, deployment documentation, and exclusive intellectual property ownership with zero recurring vendor lock-in.
3. **Indian GST Compliance:** Official 18% GST tax invoices with milestone billing in INR (₹) via UPI, IMPS, NEFT, and RTGS.
4. **Direct Engineering Communication:** Direct access to lead engineers and founder Krishndas Chauhan via WhatsApp and phone throughout scoping, development, and post-launch support.
5. **Post-Launch Warranty:** 30 to 60 days of post-launch defect remediation included on custom deliveries, with optional maintenance retainers.

---

## 3. Core Services & Capabilities

### 3.1 Web Development (https://anivexsolution.in/web-development)
- Custom corporate websites engineered for sub-second Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and Core Web Vitals compliance.
- Full-stack web platforms with client portals and real-time admin dashboards.
- E-commerce storefronts with automated GST invoicing, UPI / Razorpay payments, and WhatsApp alerts.
- Typical delivery: 1–3 weeks for business websites; 3–6 weeks for custom web platforms.

### 3.2 UI/UX Web Design (https://anivexsolution.in/web-design)
- Reusable component libraries and design systems tailored for Indian desktop and mobile screens.
- Interactive Figma prototypes reviewed prior to frontend engineering.
- WCAG-conscious contrast, readable typography (`Sora`, `Plus Jakarta Sans`, `Noto Sans Devanagari`), and SEO-friendly redesign migrations.

### 3.3 Custom Software Development (https://anivexsolution.in/software-development)
- Bespoke inventory, supply chain, manufacturing batch tracking, and accounting applications.
- Contract-first REST and GraphQL API integrations.
- Relational (PostgreSQL / MySQL) and document (Firebase Firestore) database modeling with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
- Modernization of spreadsheet or legacy desktop tools into secure cloud applications.

### 3.4 Web Application Development (https://anivexsolution.in/web-application-development)
- Multi-tenant SaaS products, dealer ordering portals, online testing systems, and property/tenant management portals.
- Secure authentication (Firebase Auth, JWT, OAuth 2.0) and real-time operational dashboards.

### 3.5 ERP Development (https://anivexsolution.in/erp-development)
- GST-compliant tax invoicing (CGST, SGST, IGST, HSN/SAC codes, PDF export).
- Multi-branch / multi-godown stock synchronization with barcode tracking and expiry/low-stock alerts.
- Customer/vendor ledgers, automated WhatsApp PDF invoice dispatch, and Tally/Excel data migration.

### 3.6 Custom Software Solutions & Automation (https://anivexsolution.in/custom-software)
- Business workflow automation pipelines, AI document intelligence (Gemini API), and specialized systems for agri-tech procurement, educational institutes, and equipment/fleet leasing.

---

## 4. Proprietary Products

1. **PolicyHub:** Enterprise policy and compliance document governance platform with granular permissions, version control, audit trails, and semantic search.
2. **VyaparDesk ERP:** Indian business GST billing, barcode stock management, and multi-warehouse inventory engine with automated WhatsApp invoice dispatch.
3. **Anivex OpsGrid:** Unified enterprise operations monitor combining modular telemetry metrics, live API status, and role-based access control.

---

## 5. Technology Stack

- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion / Motion, Vite
- **Backend & APIs:** Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI, REST & GraphQL APIs
- **Databases & Cloud:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, Firebase Auth & Firestore, Docker, AWS, Google Cloud, Netlify
- **Mobile & AI:** Android (Kotlin), React Native, Google Gemini API

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Who is the founder of Anivex Solution?**
A: Krishndas Chauhan is the Founder and Lead Architect of Anivex Solution. He holds a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) from Mangalayatan University and a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) from APCS College of IT & Management.

**Q: What regions does Anivex Solution serve?**
A: Anivex Solution is based in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh and serves businesses across Jaunpur, Machhlishahar, Varanasi, Lucknow, Kanpur, all of India, and international clients remotely.

**Q: Does Anivex Solution provide GST tax invoices and full code ownership?**
A: Yes. Official 18% GST tax invoices are issued for all engagements, payments are accepted via UPI, IMPS, NEFT, and RTGS, and clients receive 100% source code and intellectual property ownership upon completion.

**Q: How long does it take to build a website or custom ERP?**
A: Business websites generally launch within 1 to 3 weeks, while custom web applications and ERP platforms typically take 4 to 8 weeks depending on scope.
